nodes.name: Expression Engine Acceptance Criteria
nodes.summary: Defines 6 acceptance criteria (AC-001 through AC-006) for the Expression Engine, covering mathematical evaluation, string concatenation, conditional logic, nested variable resolution, undefined variable handling, and number formatting. Each AC maps to functional requirements and user stories.

nodes.name: Expression Engine API Specification
nodes.summary: Defines 3 REST API endpoints for the Expression Engine: POST /api/expressions/validate (syntax validation), POST /api/expressions/evaluate (expression evaluation with context), and POST /api/expressions/resolve (dynamic token resolution). Includes request/response schemas and error codes.

nodes.name: Expression Engine Business Rules
nodes.summary: Specifies validation rules (VR-EX-001 to VR-EX-003), permission rules (PR-EX-001 to PR-EX-002), state transition rules (Raw→Parsed→Evaluated), business constraints (parseability, division-by-zero, undefined variables, depth limit), and side effects for the Expression Engine.

nodes.name: Expression Engine Domain Model
nodes.summary: Defines core domain entities for the Expression Engine: Expression (mathematical, string, conditional, mixed types), Token (8 token types including Number, String, Variable, Operator, Comparison, Logical, Parenthesis, Function), AST (6 node types: Literal, Variable, BinaryOp, UnaryOp, FunctionCall, Conditional), and ExpressionContext (variable map with parent nesting). Describes the parse→build→evaluate pipeline and invariants.

nodes.name: Expression Engine Requirements
nodes.summary: Comprehensive requirements document for the Expression Engine covering the problem statement, objective, actors (System, Administrator), 5 user stories (math evaluation, string expressions, conditional expressions, variable resolution, output formatting), 7 functional requirements (REQ-EX-001 to REQ-EX-007), 3 non-functional requirements (performance targets), constraints, edge cases, and dependencies on Template, Component, and Administration modules.

nodes.name: Expression Engine Implementation Tasks
nodes.summary: Defines 8 implementation tasks (TASK-001 through TASK-008) in dependency order: Tokenizer → Parser → Evaluator → Variable Resolver / Formatter → API Routes → Tests → Verification. Specifies affected source files for each task and verification criteria.

nodes.name: Expression Engine Test Cases
nodes.summary: Defines comprehensive test coverage for the Expression Engine: 14 unit tests for ExpressionParser (UT-EX-001 to UT-EX-006) and ExpressionEvaluator (UT-EX-007 to UT-EX-014), 3 unit tests for VariableResolver (UT-VR-001 to UT-VR-003), 1 integration test (IT-EX-001), 4 API tests (AT-EX-001 to AT-EX-004), and 4 edge case tests (EC-EX-001 to EC-EX-004).

nodes.name: Expression Engine UI Specification
nodes.summary: Defines the Expression Engine UI components: Expression Editor (used in Template Builder, Component Builder, Administration Builder), Variable Reference Picker (triggered by @ or {{ with search), Validation Indicator (green check, red X, yellow warning states), and keyboard shortcuts ({{, @, Tab, Escape).

nodes.name: Expression Engine UX Specification
nodes.summary: Defines user experience flows for the Expression Engine: Write Expression flow (click → type → variable picker → validate → save), Variable Picker flow (trigger on {{ → search → select → insert), Real-time Validation flow (type → validate syntax → resolve variables → determine type → show feedback). Includes feedback types and keyboard shortcuts.

edges.description: Acceptance criteria map to functional requirements (REQ-EX-001 through REQ-EX-006) and user stories defined in requirements
API endpoints implement the functional requirements defined in requirements
Business rules constrain domain entity behavior and state transitions
Domain model entities realize the requirements
Implementation tasks are structured around domain entities (tokenizer, parser, evaluator, resolver, formatter)
TASK-006 implements the API routes defined in the API specification
Test cases map to functional requirements and business constraints
API tests (AT-EX-001 to AT-EX-004) validate the API endpoints
UI component specification and UX user flow specification are closely related views of the same interface
UX validation flow relies on the /api/expressions/validate endpoint
Business rules implement constraints and requirements from the requirements document
